# Case configuration
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = "simpleFoam"
final_time = 300          # steady-state: write one directory and stop

# Geometry (2D channel, millimetre scale)
# Domain in metres
x_len = 0.006   # 6 mm streamwise length
y_len = 0.002   # 2 mm height
z_len = 0.001   # 1 mm depth (single cell layer for 2D)

# Mesh
nx = 60
ny = 20
nz = 1

nu = 1.0e-04                 # kinematic viscosity (m^2/s)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def w(path, content):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "w") as f:
        f.write(content)
